objective: Continue the web development: Staff workspace

sections: 10. Delivery, validation, and completion: stage 5 and manual accessibility checks
plan.pathBasis: All source, test and receipt paths below are relative to the web checkout.

currentWebEvidence.scope: Complete local web staff inventory using real API, PostgreSQL, media processing and emulator-backed web sessions.

historicalRegressionEvidence.scope: Earlier functional build: 168 unit, 43 reading, five SEO, 16 identity, 37 editor and 46 staff cases. The current-build receipt separately proves all 46 staff cases on the presentation build.

requirements.requirement: Own/broader staff work, URL filters, server page/data authorization and generic unavailable views without private serialization.

passedTitles: staff pages and data enforce anonymous and author role boundaries without draft serialization
editor all-article filters use durable URLs while author pages stay scoped to own work
confirmed denial during review or history configuration hides already loaded private snapshots
author and editor cannot enter staff administration or call administrative data operations
taxonomy requires editor/admin page and data permission, including write attempts

requirements.requirement: Exact submitted/published comparison with metadata and image alternatives; confirmed publication including an editor's own work; feedback, revision privacy and withdrawal before editing.

passedTitles: author edits, uploads and submits; editor publishes exact content, then publishes a correction without exposing working changes
rejection requires feedback and preserves the published revision; the author can revise, resubmit and withdraw review
an editor can publish their own exact submitted revision while all decision controls remain disabled during the held response

requirements.requirement: Pending decisions retain exact input/version/key, require explicit conflict recovery and refresh authoritative state; expired replay windows require inspection.

passedTitles: a lost publication response retries identical input/version/key and records one publication event
a competing reviewer gets an explicit version conflict and must refresh before a new decision
an uncertain publication older than the replay window requires inspection and never sends another mutation
publication readback displays a newly resubmitted exact revision instead of claiming the queue is empty

requirements.requirement: Immutable revision/history reads, confirmed restore to working draft, public withdrawal, recoverable trash/purge information, and previewed collision-safe historical redirects.

passedTitles: immutable history restores a new working revision; unpublish, trash and restore never republish retained content
immutable history retains exact snapshots and locks independent cursors throughout restore readback
slug confirmation previews the redirect and historical names remain reserved to their owning article
author role cannot review or list other staff work and can recover its own never-published trash

requirements.requirement: Traverse complete authorized review, member, invitation, audit and taxonomy result pages.

passedTitles: the review queue traverses every authorized cursor page without losing or duplicating submitted revisions
staff members, invitations and filtered audit logs traverse every real cursor page without duplicates
managed taxonomy traverses every server page and keeps active and archived filters distinct

requirements.requirement: Usage counts, immutable slugs, active/archive/reactivation, retained references and active replacements, normalized duplicates, expected versions and safe interrupted-operation recovery.

passedTitles: editor creates, renames, archives and reactivates a category while its slug remains immutable
tag creation reports normalized-name and immutable-slug duplicates while retaining the proposal
archiving used vocabulary preserves published and historical references and requires active replacement before resubmission
stale taxonomy version keeps the proposal and requires explicit comparison and a newly confirmed version
lost taxonomy create response retries identical captured input and key without duplicate creation
uncertain taxonomy action stops after the replay window and resolves by authorized current-state review
a late taxonomy selection cannot replace an entry with an in-flight or uncertain saved change

requirements.contractBoundary: The pinned API exposes archive/reactivation and replacement requirements, with no bulk-reassignment/deletion operation.

requirements.requirement: Confirm role/active changes with consequences, explain last-admin denial, preserve current selection through uncertain changes/readback and refresh self-role navigation; inspect actor/time audit metadata.

passedTitles: administrator confirms role and disablement, authoritative denial takes effect, and audit filters show the actor and time
last active administrator is protected and stale membership proposals require an explicit refresh
an in-flight or uncertain staff access change keeps its member and exact retry when another member is selected
a successful staff access change keeps member selection locked until its fresh member readback completes
an administrator changing their own role receives a fresh authorized workspace and navigation

requirements.requirement: Confirmed attribution transfer creates a draft, retains the published snapshot, applies current author permissions and requires exact readback before further changes.

passedTitles: admin attribution transfer creates a new draft, preserves the published snapshot, and removes former-owner access
successful author reassignment keeps its article locked until the exact authorized readback completes
a failed author reassignment readback requires explicit ownership refresh before another mutation

requirements.requirement: Expiry/accepted/revoked states, issue/revoke/reissue, actual copy success/fallback, no email promise and explicit secret replacement after a link-free replay receipt.

passedTitles: invitation issue and revocation display a private one-time link and current audit metadata
a committed invitation response loss reuses the exact operation and offers explicit secret replacement
invitation copy uses the actual clipboard and safely supports denied or absent clipboard access
invitation status filters show accepted, expired, revoked and pending audit details with appropriate actions

requirements.requirement: Approved display name/bio, fixed handle and private email separation; retain proposals and compare fresh state after conflicts.

passedTitles: public profile edits keep private identity separate and preserve entered text on a real version conflict
successful profile readback locks manual refresh and preserves a single current comparison

requirements.requirement: Enforce CSRF and expected versions, preserve backend diagnostics, and block writes under current required-update/retirement/incompatible/outage metadata while preserving proposals.

passedTitles: staff proxy rejects missing CSRF and stale versions while preserving backend error diagnostics
fresh server metadata blocks staff mutations for required updates, retirement, incompatibility and outage without losing the proposal

requirements.requirement: Semantic controls, useful keyboard/focus behavior, both themes, accessible overflow, native zoom and actual screen-reader navigation.

passedTitles: admin and profile controls reflow in both themes and return keyboard focus after confirmation
review decisions and history support keyboard confirmation, phone reflow and both themes
taxonomy keyboard confirmation, focus restoration, phone reflow and both themes pass axe

requirements.remaining: Automated axe, focus, viewport and keyboard scrolling are verified. Native manual zoom and Narrator/Speech Recap checks were not completed; the user directed computer use to remain stopped.

remainingStaffRequirements.requiredEvidence: A real Android client publishing/reviewing shared exact revisions with the web against the same authoritative backend.
remainingStaffRequirements.currentEvidence: The user confirmed Android development has not started and there is no Android checkout. No native client/device journey evidence is available.

passedTitles: direct bearer transport and the web share exact revisions without claiming a native Android journey

remainingStaffRequirements.missing: Native Android implementation and executed cross-client journey.

remainingStaffRequirements.authorization: No further native UI checks are authorized until the user resumes computer use.
requiredEvidence: Actual screen-reader navigation and inspected announcements
Manual keyboard/focus review across the staff routes

localSessionMetadata.availability: Ignored local runtime metadata inspected for this audit.

limitations: No native zoom or Narrator check is asserted from runner readiness or closure.
Auditory intelligibility, blind-user usability and full WCAG conformance remain unverified.

separatePlanGates.evidence: User reported staging website not deployed; local emulator receipts do not establish a real configured-provider smoke.

missing: Cloud image provenance and deployment controls

auditScope.backendCleanup: Not assessed or claimed by this audit; the parent task is handling current backend cleanup.
auditScope.conclusion: Staff web implementation and the complete current automated staff run are verified. Native cross-client and manual native accessibility requirements remain incomplete, so the full objective is not achieved.
